name: Next Station
source:
You've just been rejected by the girl you had silently loved for so long... Now you embark on a journey to nowhere in particular, in the subway's circles and cycles, trying to deal with the pain everyone feels at least once in their lives: rejection.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=3363]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
暗恋许久的女孩刚刚拒绝了你……如今，你登上不断循环往复的地铁，踏上一段没有明确目的地的旅程，试图面对每个人一生中至少都会经历一次的痛苦：遭到拒绝。

[译自 [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=3363]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
